"ಸಂಚಾರ ಸಲಹೆ"
ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ನಗರದಿಂದ ಅಂತಾರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ವಿಮಾನ ನಿಲ್ದಾಣಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗುವ ಮಾರ್ಗ ಮದ್ಯೆ ಹೆಬ್ಬಾಳ ಫ್ಲೈಓವರ್ ಮೇಲೆ ಡಾಂಬರೀಕರಣ ಕಾಮಗಾರಿಯಿಂದಾಗಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಸಂಚಾರ ದಟ್ಟಣೆ  ಇದ್ದು ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕರು ಪರ್ಯಾಯ ಮಾರ್ಗವಾಗಿ ಮೇಖ್ರಿ ವೃತ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ  ಎಡ  ತಿರುವು ಪಡೆದು ಸದಾಶಿವನಗರ ಪೊಲೀಸ್ ಠಾಣೆ ಹತ್ತಿರ ಬಲ ತಿರುವು ಪಡೆದು ಹೊಸ ಬೆಲ್ ರಸ್ತೆ ಮುಖಾಂತರ ಕುವೆಂಪು ವೃತ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಲ ತಿರುವು ಪಡೆದು ಹೊರ ವರ್ತುಲ ರಸ್ತೆಯಿಂದ ಹೆಬ್ಬಾಳ ಸರ್ಕಲ್ ಮುಖಾಂತರ ವಿಮಾನ ನಿಲ್ದಾಣಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗಬಹುದು.

"Traffic Advisory"
Due to asphalting work on the Hebbal Flyover on the route from Bangalore city to the International Airport, there is heavy traffic congestion. The public can take an alternative route by taking a left turn at Mekhri Circle, then a right turn near Sadashivanagar Police Station, proceeding via New BEL Road, taking a right turn at Kuvempu Circle, and then going via the Outer Ring Road through Hebbal Circle to reach the Airport.

TIANGCO KAY ABANTE: “KARANGALAN ANG MABATIKOS NG MGA CROCODILE NI ROMUALDEZ” 

Diretsahang sinagot ni Navotas City Rep. Toby Tiangco ang pahayag ni Manila Rep. Benny Abante Jr. na tinawag siyang posibleng susunod na “meow-meow” sa Kamara.

Sa isang panayam, sinabi ni Tiangco na itinuturing niyang karangalan ang mga banat mula sa mga buwaya ni House Speaker Martin Romualdez, at mas lalo lamang umano siyang nahihikayat na ipagpatuloy ang pagbubukas ng mga hindi pa nalulutas na isyu ng katiwalian.

“Malaking karangalan sa akin na ako’y binabatikos ng mga crocodile ni Martin Romualdez…”

Mariing iginiit ni Tiangco na hindi siya titigil sa paglalantad ng mga alegasyon hangga’t wala pang napapanagot na tinatawag niyang “big fish.”

“Sabi nila huwag ko raw buhayin yung mga issue, No, pipilitin kong buhayin yang mga issues dahil wala pa namang big fish na nakukulong.”

Kinuwestiyon din ng mambabatas kung bakit tila nagiging balisa ang kanyang mga kritiko tuwing muling nababanggit ang isyu ng korapsyon.

“Ngayon ang tanong ko sa kanila, bakit kaya takot na takot sila na binubuhay ang issue?”

Ayon kay Tiangco, ang patuloy na pagbubusisi ng publiko ay mahalaga upang matiyak na may mananagot, at hindi basta matatabunan ang mga seryosong paratang sa pamahalaan.

Ang pahayag ni Tiangco ay tugon sa hamon ni Abante na ilabas ang ebidensiya o itigil na umano ang pag-uulit ng alegasyon—isang banggaan ng pananaw na lalong nagpapainit sa usapin ng pananagutan sa loob ng Kongreso.

NTSB Newsroom released a Human Performance presentation regarding the Washington DC Mid air Collision. Some notes... 🧵🔽 1/ 8

DCA ATC Tower Use of Visual Separation

- Due to proximity of helicopter routes to approach and departure corridors, pilot-applied visual separation reduced controller workload and airspace congestion and complexity 

- Controllers motivated to issue traffic advisory and authorize visual separation for transiting helicopters as early as possible 

- Local controller’s expectation that PAT25 crew would have specific aircraft (flight 5342) in sight was not valid 

-  Potential for controller to overestimate helicopter crew’s traffic awareness and underestimate level of information
